services.name: Halfmoon Lake Campground
services.desc: Welcome to Halfmoon Lake Campground, located on the shore of Halfmoon Lake in Thorhild County. Visitors can enjoy a picturesque lakeside setting, swimming area, playground, boat launch and other recreational amenities. Halfmoon Lake Campground is open annually from May 15 to September 30. The campground gates are locked from October 1 to May 15. Day-use and boat launch access is available daily from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. during the operating season. Fees apply. Please note that all campsites are seasonal. There are no overnight or short-term campsites available. All campsites at Halfmoon Lake Campground are seasonal sites and are reserved in advance for the entire camping season. Day-use
